en: Soldier. Head orange-yellow, the labrum orange-red and the mandibles red-brown with paler bases; the head bears rather sparse long hairs. Head nearly rectangular and a little broad and short, widest near the back, the hind margin almost straight or broadly rounded; the coronal suture is visible and the frons leans forward with a shallow median hollow. Eyes narrow and elongate, faintly discernible. Antennae thirteen to fourteen segmented, the third slightly longer than the second. Mandibles stout with swollen bases and slightly incurved apices, longer than half the head, and about as long as the head is high. Postmentum broad and short, divided into two lobes of which the anterior is the larger, the middle part slender and the base swollen again. Pronotum with a broad, deep anterior emargination bearing a median notch.
soldier: 兵蚁头橘黄，前唇基灰黄，上唇橘红，上颚红褐而基部略淡，触角第一、三节近橘红、其余近灰黄，胸部、腹部与足灰黄，头被较稀疏长毛。头壳近长方形，略宽短，最宽处靠近后部，后缘近平或宽圆；Y形缝可见，额略向前倾，中部略凹。眼狭长，隐约可见。触角十三至十四节，第三节略长于第二节。后唇基前缘有几根长毛；前唇基宽扁近梯形；上唇近方形，前缘宽圆，背面及近前缘生几根长毛。上颚粗壮，基部膨大，顶端略内弯，长度超过头壳之半，头高与左上颚近等长。后颏宽短，前端最宽处两侧缘中部略内凹而分前、后两叶，前叶略大于后叶，中段细长，近基部又明显膨大。头侧观背缘略隆，后颏稍突。前胸背板前缘宽而深凹，中部具切刻，后缘中央稍内凹。
